title: Does the source support this code?

parts.speech: When you see a proposed code, the first question is simple: does the source really support it?
parts.label: Start with the evidence

parts.speech: Click the page number to find the passage on the right. Let’s walk through the review from here.
parts.label: Here is the source passage

parts.speech: Start with three areas. Choose a report on the left.
parts.label: 1. Choose a report

parts.speech: Check the coding in the middle, with the original text alongside it.
parts.label: 2. Check the coding

parts.speech: Use the list at the top left. All pilot reports shows the whole set.
parts.label: All pilot reports

parts.speech: To pick up where you left off, choose Verification pending.
parts.label: Verification pending

parts.speech: You can also focus on included or excluded reports.
parts.label: Excluded reports

parts.speech: This report is marked Excluded, so further extraction stops here.
parts.label: Further extraction stops

parts.speech: The reason and its evidence remain available. You can still check the passage in context.
parts.label: Reason and evidence stay visible

title: Confirm it, or explain the change

parts.speech: After checking the evidence, choose Correct if this item is right.
parts.label: Agree? Choose Correct

parts.speech: If something needs changing, choose Revise.
parts.label: Need a change? Choose Revise

parts.speech: A note box opens below. Explain what is wrong and how you think it should change.
parts.label: Explain the proposed change

parts.speech: Once every item has feedback, the report moves to Verification complete.
parts.label: Every item has feedback

parts.speech: But look: one revision is still recorded. The team needs to resolve it.
parts.label: One revision still needs attention

parts.speech: Now open an included report. These four tabs organize the work.
parts.label: Four stages; choose your task

parts.speech: In Screening, expand Foundational conditions and check each requirement.
parts.label: Open Foundational conditions

title: Follow the rule back to its evidence

parts.speech: Each judgment includes a reason and a source you can inspect.
parts.label: Judgment → reason → source

parts.speech: Next, look at Construct pathways. These conditions come from the team’s codebook.
parts.label: Construct pathways: team rules

parts.speech: Review profile brings together the question, scope, and methods of this review.
parts.label: Review profile

parts.speech: Start with that overview, then check the individual items below.
parts.label: Move from overview to details

parts.speech: In Concepts, compare the source’s definitions with the team’s descriptive coding.
parts.label: Compare definitions and coding

parts.speech: Deciding whether that mapping makes sense is a human judgment.
parts.label: People judge the concept mapping

parts.speech: This stage captures the claims and conditions reported by this particular review.
parts.label: What this review reports

parts.speech: Check the level of evidence behind each claim. This is not a completed synthesis across reviews.
parts.label: Check the evidence level

title: From a page number to the sentence

parts.speech: For this example, click PDF page eighteen to find the cited sentence.
parts.label: 1. Click PDF p. 18

parts.speech: Yellow helps you locate it. Read the context before deciding whether the code is supported.
parts.label: 2. Find it, then read the context

title: Need more room for the PDF?

parts.speech: If the PDF feels cramped, drag the divider to the left.
parts.label: Drag the divider left

parts.speech: The source now has more space.
parts.label: More room for the PDF

parts.speech: For small text, use the zoom control at the top right.
parts.label: Adjust the zoom here

parts.speech: At one hundred and fifty percent, both the text and its highlight become larger.
parts.label: 150%: a closer view

parts.speech: Scroll inside the PDF to read more context. The coding panel stays in place.
parts.label: Scroll the source independently

title: Turn the page, then return your feedback

parts.speech: Use the arrow to turn the page. The previous highlight clears.
parts.label: Turn to the next page

parts.speech: When you finish this round, export your feedback and return it to the team.
parts.label: Export verification

title: AI prepares; people make the judgments

parts.speech: Develop the rules on a sample first. Then AI can prepare the next batch for people to verify.
parts.label: People develop rules and verify

parts.speech: The aim is to make evidence easier to find and compare, so people can make informed judgments.
parts.label: Keep each judgment close to evidence
